images.birds_sky_morning: Many colorful birds flying together in a bright morning sky over green hills and a calm river, joyful and free.
images.wind_over_land: Strong gentle wind sweeping over golden grass fields and treetops, swirls of leaves in the air, soft clouds moving fast, sunny day.
images.ant_valley: Close-up of a tiny friendly cartoon ant standing on a pebble in a sunny valley, many small ant holes in the soil around it, grass blades like trees.
images.ant_hills_safe: Little ant hills in warm soil with tiny ants walking in neat lines into their holes, soft afternoon light, safe and cozy.
images.hoopoe_branch: A beautiful hoopoe bird with its crown of orange feathers sitting on a branch, looking curious, soft blue sky background.
images.sun_worship_far: A distant ancient city of Saba in a green valley with a big golden sunrise behind it, gardens and a large stone dam, peaceful landscape view.
images.letter_seal_bird: A rolled parchment letter with a red wax seal lying on a stone ledge, a hoopoe feather beside it, warm light, no readable letters.
images.gift_chests: Open wooden treasure chests with gold and jewels in a palace hall, soft light, nobody present.
images.throne_appears: A grand ornate golden throne with soft magical sparkles around it in an empty palace hall, warm light, nobody present.
images.glass_floor_palace: A palace hall with a perfectly clear glass floor over shallow water with fish and lilies beneath, reflections of columns, sunlight, nobody present.
